The repository states Proposition 9.6 as a preservation theorem for an explicit stage invariant along an explicitly constructed four-stage map. Every clause lines up: σ ↦ σ+1/10 gives both B_{j+1}=B_j+1/10 and C*_{j+1}=C*_j+1/10 because B=1/2+σ and C*=1+σ are the invariant's own exponents; (9.9) is `cumulative`+`wave`+`difference`, (9.10) is `masses`; the four corrections are the literal composition afterParticular→afterSigned→afterTemporal→afterRank, each followed by pressure reconstruction; the meridional mean increments are literally stream potentials and the azimuthal one is added directly. It is a reformulation, not a restatement, because Lean names the successor state instead of asserting existence, adds coherence and periodicity, and carries a largeness hypothesis on N0.

findings.summary: next_runInvariant carries a largeness hypothesis `ActualCarrierGeometry.geometricThreshold ≤ N0` on the band-count parameter that has no counterpart in the paper's Proposition 9.6, which quantifies only over states at stage j.

Of the realization clause, the mean half is literal in the cycle (stream potentials for β and γ, direct azimuthal addition), but the wave half — increments as curls of their potentials — is not in next_runInvariant; the invariant records only per-mode solenoidality.
